options.name: check_password
options.description: Default flag to disable user password checking. Can be overridden per item. Password checking performs a real login per user; consider C(false) for large batches.

options.name: enforce_mfa_enrollment
options.description: Default flag whether users are forced to enroll MFA at their next login. Can be overridden per item. If unset, the flag is left untouched, e.g. when it is managed via the Admin UI.

options.name: grant_types
options.description: Default list of supported grant types for all items. Can be overridden per item.

options.name: identity_provider
options.description: Default identity source for all items. Can be overridden per item.

options.name: items
options.description: Users to manage. Each item uses the same user-specific fields as C(cybus.connectware.user).

options.name: manage_permissions
options.description: Default flag whether to reconcile the users' direct permissions. Can be overridden per item. Set this to C(false) for LDAP or Microsoft Entra ID users when direct permissions should not be managed.

options.name: max_concurrent
options.description: Maximum number of user operations to run concurrently. This limits worker threads in this module. The Connectware auth service is typically the bottleneck under parallel load; increase this value only after validating auth service load.

options.name: password
options.description: Default user password for all items. Can be overridden per item.

options.name: permissions
options.description: Default list of permissions for all items. Can be overridden per item (not merged; the item list replaces the default).

options.name: roles
options.description: Default list of existing roles for all items. Can be overridden per item (not merged; the item list replaces the default).

options.name: state
options.description: Default target state for Connectware Users. Can be overridden per item.

options.name: target_hostname
options.description: Used to connect to the Connectware API.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Flag to enable Connectware certificate checking.
